name: progress
behavior: APG meter/progressbar pattern (role=progressbar with aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow; omit aria-valuenow when indeterminate; label via aria-label/aria-labelledby)

parts.statesNote: determinate: inline-size bound to value fraction; indeterminate: fixed-length segment sweeping the track in a loop

anatomyNotes: Determinate is the rest state with the indicator sized by value. Linear form is canonical here; circular progress is the same two parts (track/indicator) rendered as strokes — a recipe difference. shadcn's action-at-20%-opacity track vs Salt's neutral track are both theme recipes on surface-sunken.
